text_block_list.text:
Wondering if there was any way I could 
help with Agnes Tachyon's research, I was 
browsing the library for books about 
Umamusume when...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-kun. What are you doing in a 
place like this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose the main thing to do in a 
library would be reading books, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of things are you 
interested in—oh?
choice_data_list:
I thought it might help with your 
research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, hahaha! Well aren't you pulling off 
something quite admirable!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Right now, what I desire most from you is 
a mind and body healthy enough to carry 
out our experiments!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you say it's for my sake, then let's 
start with basic physical conditioning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You are truly fortunate. I just so happen 
to have an experiment I've been wanting to 
try.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If this experiment succeeds, anyone, no 
matter how terribly unhealthy they may be, 
will achieve peak physical condition 
without fail!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin! The experiment to grant 
you the ultimate physique!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... I can hardly wait for the 
results, Trainer-kun♪

"Perhaps uplifted by the spirit of 
cooperation, Agnes Tachyon was in even 
higher spirits than usual."
